note: For review. Not applied. Check the period and rule count your plan allows (the Free plan may allow a single rule: then apply rule 1 and widen its expression with the paths of rule 2). The Stripe webhook is left out on purpose.

rules.expression: http.request.method eq "POST" and (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/accounts/login" or http.request.uri.path eq "/api/accounts/register" or http.request.uri.path eq "/api/accounts/password/forgot")

rules.description: 2. Staff sign-in and second factor (added by the 2026-11-12 audit; the application also locks the account after repeated failures)
rules.expression: http.request.method eq "POST" and (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/admin/auth/login" or http.request.uri.path eq "/api/admin/auth/mfa/verify")

rules.description: 3. Public forms that send e-mail or store personal data (contact form, enquiries); well above what a person needs
